caption: Figure 3 | RMSE increments from aerosol optical depth (AOD) and fire predictors. Panels compare (A) B+AOD minus B, (B) full minus (B+AOD), and (C) full minus B. Points and bars show estimates and simultaneous 95% max-|t| intervals across all 78 contrasts, using 10,000 Exp(1) station-multiplier draws. The family contains 26 United States/Canada task–meteorology units. Intervals exclude zero in favor of the added predictors in 24/26, 12/26 and 26/26 comparisons, respectively. Rows group 13 country–task combinations with meteorological profiles offset. Negative ΔRMSE favors the added predictors; units are µg m⁻³. B denotes the base model with location, population and seasonal predictors. MET denotes meteorological predictors. T1 denotes station grouping, T2 spatial blocking, T2 buffer the 50-km buffer, T3 2022 forward-year validation, and T4 fixed-window future-year evaluation.
